info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Settlement Hold-spec
info.description: The Settlement Hold Management API enables businesses to place a hold on specific settlements identified by their unique settlement ID. This functionality is essential for managing cash flows and ensuring compliance with financial regulations by temporarily restricting access to certain funds. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors that need to manage settlement processes. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently maintain control over their financial operations while handling various settlement scenarios.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to place a hold on a settlement identified by its unique ID, ensuring that it cannot be processed until the hold is removed. This is useful for managing settlement states and preventing further actions on them until resolved.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to hold the settlement identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the necessary details are provided in accordance with the defined schema.
